setup.text: Lanterns hang in a row along the Arch, their wicks freshly dressed for the night. The priest dips a taper into the rite-fire, sending the flame to the nearest lantern in one smooth motion. The wick catches and holds steady.

option_a.text:
The player asks, "Does the flame run out?"

The priest answers, "Depends how far it's asked to go. One flame, one send."

option_b.text: The player dips a second taper into the rite-fire and sends the flame to the next lantern along the row, which catches and holds steady.

option_c.text: The player sends the flame toward the rain barrel at the edge of the grounds. It lands on the water and goes out, the flame spent for nothing.
